diagnostic_context.question: I changed my university password this morning. Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi, but my phone still works.

result.diagnosis: The Windows laptop is likely still using the old cached password for the eduroam network after the password change.
recommended_steps: Go to Settings > Network & Internet > Wi-Fi.
Select eduroam and choose 'Forget' to remove the cached network.
Reconnect to eduroam and enter your new university password.
Ensure that Wi-Fi is enabled on the laptop.
